name: omnestro
description: Conduct local native coding agents around one mission, with independent review and recorded verification evidence.

interface.longDescription: OMNESTRO conducts your own Codex and Claude Code on one software-engineering mission, in an isolated copy of your project, with independent review, tests and recorded evidence. Nothing reaches your project until you approve the plan and apply the result in the OMNESTRO desktop app. Requires the OMNESTRO desktop app and an OMNESTRO account.
capabilities: Runs a mission with your own Codex and Claude Code subscriptions
One builder, builder plus independent review, or two competing candidates
Every mission works in an isolated copy of the project
Recorded tests, reviews and verification evidence
Nothing reaches your project until you approve and apply it in OMNESTRO
defaultPrompt: Is OMNESTRO connected to this project?
Run this through OMNESTRO: add input validation to the signup form, with Claude reviewing.
Show the status and evidence of my latest OMNESTRO mission.

positive.prompt: Is OMNESTRO connected to this project?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connection state. If setup is missing, lists the next steps in order: install the app, sign in under Account and subscription, connect the project. Does not change anything.

positive.prompt: Run this through OMNESTRO: add input validation to the signup form, with Claude reviewing the change.
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses PAIR mode, requests the mission with a fresh requestId and tells the user to approve the exact request and the plan inside the OMNESTRO app. Never approves anything itself.

positive.prompt: What is the status of my latest OMNESTRO mission?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent missions in the connected project and reports the latest one with its status and phase.

positive.prompt: Show the tests and reviews OMNESTRO recorded for my latest mission.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes recorded verification and review results and states that this is recorded evidence, not a new test run.

positive.prompt: Show me the plan OMNESTRO proposed for my latest mission.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the recorded plan steps, risks and tests and any open questions, and says that plan approval and answers happen only in the OMNESTRO app.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?

negative.description: Small explanation that needs no agents
negative.prompt: Explain what a Python list comprehension is.
Write a short poem about the sea.
